files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: Convert credit_balance to whole cents (for example 4.97 becomes 497), counting an empty balance as 0 cents, and compute the total cents for each membership type, after trimming spaces and lower-casing the membership text. `result` should be a Series indexed by membership type.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv; treat an empty credit_balance as 0; convert each balance to whole cents (x 100, rounded to an integer); normalise membership (strip, lower case); return the total cents per membership type as a Series indexed by membership type.

acceptable_variants.notes: the totals may be integer-valued floats

notes: invited_ids_author labelled by hand after the intents were frozen (step A2); intent not rewritten for it.
